name: Food Network's Top 10
overview: With opinions everywhere about where to find the best bites, Food Network cuts through the noise with Food Network's Top 10 - a new series delivering definitive, crave-worthy rankings of the can't miss dishes across America. Award-winning chefs break down the bites that are truly worth the hype, the splurge, and even a road trip, with the rankings driven by firsthand experience, expertise, and passionate debate about what makes a truly great dish. Each episode counts down the Top 10 in a craveable category - from Brunch and BBQ to Burgers and Pizza - serving up expert insight, insider intel, saucy secrets, and plenty of hot takes along the way.
